planned_title: Is a Star Really Coming Towards Us?
spoken: There is a star coming towards us. The star has been measured, and it is heading almost straight at the sun. Its name is Gliese 710. It is an orange dwarf, a little smaller and cooler than the sun, It will not hit anything, but it will sail right through the outer edge of our solar system. In about one point three million years, it will pass closer to us than any star we know of.

brief.frame_0: NASA SDO solar flare, 9:16 centre crop, offset 32.0 s, played at 1.7x.
brief.loop_sentence: In about one point three million years, it will pass closer to us than any star we know of. There is a star coming towards us.
